name: 45 degree twisting hyperextension
description: A back extension on a 45 degree bench with a rotation at the top that adds work for the obliques and lower back.
instructions: Position yourself on the bench with your ankles under the pads and your hips just off the edge.
Cross your arms over your chest and lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise your torso back up, squeezing your glutes.
At the top, rotate your upper body gently to one side, then return to center.
Alternate sides each rep and keep the movement slow and controlled.
